chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this hadith as a cornerstone of Shia theological optimism, asserting that the Divine Essence perceives only goodness, which serves as the basis for the Imam's role as the perfect mirror of God's attributes. This concept reinforces the doctrine of *al-Hasan* (the Good) in divine perception, distinguishing it from human limited views, and underscores the continuity of divine benevolence (*rahmah*) through the Imams.
